provider: Mail.bg — 50 GB free mailbox with free IMAP/POP, Bulgarian

free_tier.stated: Signup page, Waybacks capture 2026-02-23: "50 GB пощенска кутия", "20 MB приложения (атачмънти)", "1 GB файл до всяка поща по света". = 50 GB mailbox, 20 MB attachment cap, 1 GB file to any mailbox worldwide.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: Unmetered; mailbox service, no transfer billing.

tooling: IMAP probe-verified live: `imap.mail.bg:993` -> `* OK IMAP4 ready` / `* CAPABILITY IMAP4 IMAP4rev1 QUOTA UIDPLUS MULTIAPPEND BINARY IDLE AUTH=PLAIN`. QUOTA and MULTIAPPEND support is notable. You can read remaining bytes in-band and append several messages per round trip.
chaining: 50 GB × N free accounts. Also offers free mail hosting on a user-owned domain, which means many mailboxes per domain rather than per signup. The multiplier is domains, not accounts.
limits_note: Per-object-cap 20 MB per attachment (the binding constraint. 50 GB / 20 MB = ~2,500 messages to fill). No published daily upload meter. IMAP QUOTA extension present so the real byte ceiling is readable before you fill it.
